decisions.decision: Added Ruler History as a new Leaderboard page: a step chart of adm+dip+mil per selected nation from rulerterm_manager joined against character_db
decisions.why: explicit user stretch-goal request, end of a long session

decisions.decision: ruler_history table column order must match the adapter row-tuple order exactly, folded directly into CREATE TABLE rather than an ALTER TABLE migration
decisions.why: discovered insertRows bulk-insert path (db.ts) inserts positionally via DuckDB-Wasm insertArrowTable, not by column name; an ALTER-TABLE-appended column order mismatched the adapters tuple order and silently miscast a string into a DOUBLE column, caught by the test suite
decisions.rejected: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN migration (unnecessary since this table never shipped to a real user)

decisions.decision: Real ruler names resolved via a new tools/ruler-names-scraping/generate.ts that reuses encyclopedia-scrapings parseLocalization, committed to src/components/Overview/rulerNames.json (~4670 entries)
decisions.why: explicit user request for actual names, not Ruler #N; save only stores a raw localization key (first_name), never display text
decisions.rejected: showing regnal-number-only labels permanently (kept only as the graceful fallback for an unresolvable key)

decisions.decision: Custom tooltipFormatter + axisPointer snap:false for step charts, doing our own step-lookup instead of trusting ECharts default nearest-point tooltip
decisions.why: user-observed bug: ECharts axis-trigger tooltip snaps to whichever of two flanking points is pixel-nearest, wrong on one side of a steps own boundary

decisions.decision: AddCountryInput (originally World Goods-only) generalized with an optional placeholder prop and adopted as the standard country-selection control for LeaderboardTab and RulerHistoryChart, replacing the old Search countries toggle button + CountrySearchOverlay panel
decisions.why: explicit user request: that pattern should be the standard across all graphs and charts
decisions.rejected: keeping CountrySearchOverlay + toggle button, or building a separate near-duplicate component

decisions.decision: Ruler History Ranking view shows time-weighted average skill (from first recorded reign to now) plus current rulers skill as a secondary column on LeaderboardRankingTable
decisions.why: explicit user request: a ranking table with both average and current ruler history, viewable through a tab
decisions.rejected: a single-value ranking table with only the average

decisions.decision: Sort ruler_history reigns client-side by parsed decimal year in loadRulerHistory instead of trusting SQLs ORDER BY start_date
decisions.why: real bug found live: start_date is TEXT and not zero-padded, so SQL text-sort put same-year reigns with double-digit months before single-digit ones, corrupting reign order fed into the time-weighted average and producing impossible averages over 300
decisions.rejected: reformatting start_date to a zero-padded/sortable string at parse time (more invasive, touches the adapter and every other date-text column)

decisions.decision: LeaderboardRankingTables value columns use explicit value-header/value classes on both th and td instead of a :last-child selector
decisions.why: user-observed bug: adding the secondary (Current Ruler Skill) column silently retargeted :last-child from the 3rd to the 4th column, right-aligning only the value cell and leaving its header left-aligned, a visible misalignment
decisions.rejected: keeping :last-child and adding a :nth-last-child(2) rule for the primary column (still positional and fragile to future column count changes)

implement.summary: Fixed two real bugs found live in Ruler History: reign ordering corrupted by lexicographic TEXT date sort (impossible >300 averages), and the ranking tables secondary-column header misaligned from its values.
